LESSON: READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING 3.3 Reading phrases By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners are ass
Topic 3.4: Reading comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading comprehension. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what you read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read aloud short texts and stories accurately
2. read at an appropriate speed for enjoyment
3. develop an interest in reading short stories with comprehension pictures

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read aloud short texts and stories accurately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read aloud short texts and stories accurately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. read at an appropriate speed for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read at an appropriate speed for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. develop an interest in reading short stories with comprehension pictures
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in reading short stories with comprehension pictures. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Reading comprehension.
2. Explain Reading comprehension to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading comprehension.
4. Show that you can: read aloud short texts and stories accurately
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading comprehension. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what you read?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. read aloud short texts and stories accurately
2. read at an appropriate speed for enjoyment
3. develop an interest in reading short stories with comprehension pictures

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
